_comment: Model manifest consumed by docker/bootstrap-models.sh. Paths in 'dest' are relative to <models-root>/models and must match the worker's volume layout: checkpoints/ (full checkpoints), unet/ (diffusion models), clip/ (text encoders), vae/, loras/. Only enabled entries are downloaded. Never put tokens here - use the env var named in auth.env. If this repo is public, keep only public URLs here; private/pre-signed URLs belong in a volume-local manifest (MANIFEST_PATH=/runpod-volume/config/manifest.json).

models._comment: Small, public smoke-test file. Keep enabled to verify volume + downloader end-to-end without any token.

Prefect Pony XL v6 (Pony/SDXL checkpoint) - https://civitai.com/models/439889?modelVersionId=2114187. Pony models expect the score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up prefix. Civitai answers 401 without a token, so CIVITAI_TOKEN is required on the endpoint/pre-warm pod.

Public/CloudFront URLs are safe to commit. A pre-signed URL is a bearer secret and expires: keep it in a volume-local manifest instead (MANIFEST_PATH=/runpod-volume/config/manifest.json). Generate one with: aws s3 presign s3://bucket/key --expires-in 604800
